ai.summaryInstruction: Provide a concise summary of the document below. For each role, mention the employer, the position, and the time period. Use bullet points.
ai.chatContextInstruction: Answer the question based only on the document context below. Be concise and accurate. If the answer is not in the context, say so. Cite page numbers where relevant.

share.note: PDFluent creates no cloud link. Sharing produces a file you send yourself.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: PDFluent processes this document on this device. Sharing creates a local copy, export, or email draft — no cloud link is created and no PDF is uploaded.
privacy.documentDataDetail: PDF bytes, annotations, and text extraction stay local to the active session.
privacy.crashDetail: Errors are shown in the app and not sent automatically. Feedback goes through an explicit user action.
privacy.osDetail: Native OCR, TTS, scanner, and spellcheck appear only when the capability layer reports them available.

commentName.title: Comment name
commentName.intro: This name is stored locally and used for comments and document events on this device.

native.title: Native features
native.intro: PDFluent uses OS providers as interchangeable local services. Unavailable features stay hidden or fall back to a local provider.

protect.lede: Protect your PDF document with strong cryptographic passwords. Changes are applied locally right away.
protect.userPasswordDesc: This password is required to open and view the document at all.
protect.ownerPasswordDesc: This password is required to later change permissions (such as printing, copying text, or allowing edits).

watermark.lede: Place a text watermark across all pages of this document to mark confidentiality.
